chunks: And from him, from Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Abu Khalid al-Wasiti, from Zayd ibn Ali, from his father, from his grandfather (peace be upon them), who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "The obligation of disobedience upon parents towards their children is equal to the obligation of their children's disobedience towards them."
ai.seo_question: What is the reciprocal duty of parents and children regarding obedience and rights?
ai.summary: Transmitted through the chain of Zayd ibn Ali to Imam Ali, this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes a reciprocal ethical symmetry, asserting that parental 'uquq' (neglect of rights) is as blameworthy as filial disobedience. This principle underscores the Shia emphasis on mutual rights rather than unilateral authority, framing the parent-child relationship as a covenant of justice. It serves as a foundational text for understanding the moral obligations of parents in nurturing and respecting their children's rights.
